dish.title: Harissa Roasted Carrots with Feta
dish.name: Harissa Roasted Carrots with Feta
dish.description: Harissa-roasted carrots with feta, mint, lemon, and couscous cooked in salted water.

recipe_version.title: Harissa Roasted Carrots with Feta
recipe_version.description: Harissa-roasted carrots with feta, mint, lemon, and couscous cooked in salted water.
recipe_version.doneness: Carrots tender and browned at the edges. Couscous fluffy.

ingredients.name: harissa paste
ingredients.note: Store-bought paste. Salt level varies by brand.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Boiling, for the couscous. It is absorbed.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: Juice over the carrots after roasting. No plated wedge required.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 4 g on the carrots, 2 g in the couscous water (about 0.8% of 1 cup, and the water is absorbed). 6 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (2.25 tsp). The same weight is 1.25 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 1 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Heat the oven to 425 F. Toss the carrots with the harissa paste, neutral oil, and 4 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Roast 30 minutes, until tender and browned at the edges.

steps.title: Couscous
steps.body: Stir the couscous and the remaining 2 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt into the boiling water. Cover 5 minutes off the heat, then fluff. The 2 g in 1 cup is about 0.8% and the water is absorbed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Squeeze the lemon over the carrots. Top with the feta and the mint. Serve over the couscous.
